messages:
alex: Quick thread — did allocator-sampler and full nsys heapshot on kvcache load; saw recurring cudaMalloc spikes aligned with KV cache slab growth. Summaries and samples below.

maya: link? commands?

alex: Uploaded snapshots: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-perf/heapshots/1828459012-sampler-vs-nsys.png

alex: Commands I used:
```
# lightweight periodic sampling
python tools/alloc_sampler.py --pid 12345 --interval 10 --duration 120 --out out/sampler.csv

# nsys heapshot
nsys profile --trace=cuda,cudaDriver --sample=none -o nsys_heap --force --capture-range=__start_region__:__end_region__ ./run_kvcache_workload.sh
```

sam: Interesting — in the sampler CSV the top hotspot is 'cudaMalloc' bursts at ~11.8s, 35 calls in 0.5s window. In nsys timeline the long kernel before those calls is `kv_pack_prefix_k` (GPU compute), not an allocator kernel.

natalie: Could this be deferred allocation from batch packing? i.e., the pack kernel touches pages that trigger cudaMallocHost? Any hostalloc/hostpagefault traces?

alex: I checked nvtx markers; packing finishes then host side prep does a round of small allocations: samples show many ~4KB allocations from arena slab allocator. The pool seems to request new device buffers when insertion rate crosses threshold.

sam: Do we have arena stats (free chunk sizes)? If fragmentation causes many small allocations, increasing slab size might amortize. Also check kvcache eviction frequency — eviction triggers reclaim that allocs temp buffers.

maya: I attached CSV of sampler histograms (small/medium/large alloc bins) and diff vs nsys heapshot. The diff shows a 12% increase in small allocs in the sampler window.

perf-bot: Perf job 2026-03-16T09:40:12Z completed — compare ids: sampler#112 vs nsys#45 :eyes:

alex: Proposal: change arena slab threshold from 16KB->64KB for this workload, and add a short-lived object pooling path for temp buffers in pack path. Can we run a quick AB with --arena-slab=64k?

maya: I'll queue a dedicated run on staging with kvcache-heavy config. Also add nvtx around pack+alloc path so we can correlate host allocations with kernel names.

sam: Also add an nsys sampling variant with `--samples-mem` to capture allocation backtraces; that will confirm callsites.

alex: Agreed. I'll instrument pack code with backtrace + counters and post results. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
